title: Cragmaw Castle · Area 2 · Hall collapse

sourceRecords.title: Area 2 · Falling rubble
read: A wide hall disappears into half-light. Dust lies thick around a pile of fallen plaster, and closed doors lead away on either side.

The fallen plaster marks one part of the floor as different from the rest. Beyond it, the closed doors give you choices without revealing what lies behind them. You can inspect the ground, listen at a door, or choose a position that keeps the entrance in sight.

brief: SAME entrance corridor, now LOCAL ceiling-collapse variant: fallen heavy stones and wooden beams amid dust in eastern corridor, doors/route boundaries remain. No explosions, corpses or invented spike pit. Show hazard aftermath without asserting campaign triggered it.
